question: Ali Akbar Khan was associated with which of the following gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maihar gharana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ali Akbar Khan was a renowned Indian classical musician, known for his mastery of the **sarod**.
 
• He was a prominent figure associated with the **Maihar gharana**, a school of music founded by his father, Allauddin Khan.
 
• The Maihar gharana is known for its emphasis on instrumental music, especially the sarod and sitar.
 
• Ali Akbar Khan contributed significantly to popularizing Indian classical music in the West and established the Ali Akbar College of Music in the USA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gharanas in Indian Classical Music**

 
 
• A gharana is a system of social organization linking musicians or dancers by lineage or apprenticeship, and by adherence to a particular musical style.
 
• Each gharana has its own unique style, repertoire, and teaching methodology, and is often named after the place it originated from.
 
 
 
• **Maihar Gharana**
 
 
• Founded by Ustad Allauddin Khan in the early 20th century, the Maihar gharana is known for its emphasis on instrumental music.
 
• It has produced several prominent musicians, including Ravi Shankar, Nikhil Banerjee, and Ali Akbar Khan.
 
 
 
• **Other Gharanas**
 
 
• **Agra Gharana:** Known for its khayal singing, it originated in Agra and places emphasis on the dhrupad style of singing.
 
• **Gwalior Gharana:** One of the oldest gharanas, it is known for its khayal singing and has a well-structured raga presentation.
 
• **Kirana Gharana:** Known for its melodious and emotional style, it emphasizes the purity of notes and is famed for its slow-tempo renditions.
